Click the watch buttons, or use the controls below.
Watch buttons: upper-left = light · lower-left = change mode · right = start/stop or alarm toggle. In clock mode, RESET switches between 12- and 24-hour time. Your alarm sounds while this page is open and audio has been enabled by a click. Everything works offline.
